description: A class receives its collaborators (usually through the constructor) instead of creating them, so implementations can be swapped and faked in tests.
The single place at the application edge where the object graph is wired, by hand or with a container.
A registry of factories that builds services and their dependencies on demand.
How long an instance lives: singleton (one per container), transient (new per resolve) or scoped (one per request).
Anti-pattern where business code calls `container.resolve` itself, hiding its dependencies.
`register` returns `Container<Services & { [P in K]: T }>`, so the services map type gains one key per registration.
